law: This pointer is mutable. The INSELFACTION it names is not. A correction appends a successor archive; it never edits a predecessor. `latest_inselfaction` names only the most RECENT transmission — it does not close, supersede or rank the others. Open authority items are enumerated in `open_items`, which is the field to read before assuming nothing is pending.
channel_invariants: INV-ISX-REVIEW-RESOLVABILITY — an INSELFACTION that transfers review authority MUST expose the reviewed source through a receiver-resolvable immutable reference. If the source chamber has no accessible remote: transport.review_status = BLOCKED_SOURCE_UNRESOLVABLE. This is a transport property and must not be recorded inside `source`, where it reads as provenance.

INV-E3-CANDIDATE-AUTHENTICITY — an adjudicator may confer E3 only when the candidate's detector event is reconstructable from its persisted source observations. Candidate metadata may identify a detection result; it may never prove one occurred.
INV-E3-COVERAGE-NO-RETROFIT — an evaluation example may not be used both to motivate a detector mutation and to independently validate that mutation.

INV-E3-CORPUS-MINIMIZATION — a coverage corpus may preserve only the content required to determine whether an observable E3 event occurred and whether the detector recognized it; privacy reduction must not alter the event-bearing language.
